blocks.text: In an advisory, the flag carrier said it was closely monitoring the disruption affecting air traffic operations across the United States. “PAL flights to and from U.S. airports are being monitored on a per-flight basis,” the airline said. READ: All departing US flights grounded due to communication problem PAL advised passengers to check their flight status through its official communication channels for the latest updates. The airline did not specify whether any of its flights had been delayed or canceled due to the disruption. /dm... Keep on reading: PAL monitors US flights amid FAA ground stop
